note: Transcribed from the doubt-reviewer's hand-back by the coordinator (text abridged; the SubagentStop salvage hook wrote no file).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: fr_trace_coverage at ERROR blocks only untraced requirements
doubts.disproof_attempt: The positional regex reads cell 3 as Name; an older '| ID | Name | Priority |' spec yields Name='Must' and hard-blocks update-step. Both shared fixtures had to be rewritten to 7 columns.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Read Names header-driven (fr_table_reader) instead of positionally.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a legitimate interview run satisfies 'one trace per FR'
doubts.disproof_attempt: Nothing ties a trace to an FR row; one requirement decomposed into N FRs leaves N-1 rows untraced, and the fastest way to clear the gate is hand-writing extra traces.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Carry the requirement_key into the FR row at Step 6, or keep ERROR only for 'zero FRs match'.

doubts.disproof_attempt: It rejects only a denylist of self-attesting tokens; 'user' with a transcript 'x' passes; omitting the pointer phrase skips the brief_dir requirement.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Narrow the claim to a structural screen.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: an unusable --brief file is refused on the run CLI
doubts.disproof_attempt: A Windows path with spaces ending in .pdf bypasses the refusal; a sentence ending in 'package.json' is wrongly refused as a file.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: One shape rule for both suffix arms; tests for both.

doubts.disproof_attempt: An adopted repo (code/observed FRs, no traces) later run through /shipwright-project newly blocks on every adopted FR.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Exclude non-interview Basis rows, or show the flow is unsupported.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a spec without parseable FR rows cannot hide a partial interview
doubts.disproof_attempt: An FR table the positional regex misses yields SKIPPED 'no FR rows found' while the canonical reader counts them.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: brief-mode sign-off passes when run_config records brief_dir
doubts.disproof_attempt: A BOM-prefixed run_config fails json.loads under utf-8 (brief_dir_intake reads utf-8-sig); spec reads lack an OSError guard.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Read with utf-8-sig; guard the spec read.
